title: Forged DDOT Emergency Placards & TOPS Permit Logs: 16th St SE Federal Park Swamp

communications.subject: DC Freedom of Information Act Request: Forged DDOT Emergency Placards & TOPS Permit Logs: 16th St SE Federal Park Swamp
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the DC Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

TO:   Ryann Sargent, DDOT FOIA Officer <ryann.sargent@dc.gov>; Victoria Fleming, DC WATER FOIA Officer <victoria.fleming@dc.gov>CC: oig.hotline@epa.gov; richard.jackson2@dc.gov; sharon.kershbaum@dc.gov; david.gadis@dcwater.com; foia@dcwater.com; ddot.foia@dc.gov; pmendelson@dccouncil.us; callen@dccouncil.gov; serena_bellew@nps.gov; michael_donato@nps.gov; dondrae.maiden@sol.doi.gov; Square5815Oversight@gmail.com  SUBJECT: EXPEDITED FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT (FOIA) REQUEST: Work Orders, TOPS Permits, and Dispatch Records for Square 5815 / Morris Rd SE

Pursuant to the District of Columbia Freedom of Information Act, D.C. Official Code § 2-531 et seq., I hereby request expedited production of the following public records:

1. WORK ORDERS & ASSET MANAGEMENT: All internal DC Water work orders, service tickets, maintenance requests, and work tickets generated within DC Water’s enterprise asset management system (e.g., Maximo) from September 1, 2026, through October 4, 2026, concerning Square 5815, Lot 802, 16th St SE, or the adjacent public right-of-way.
2. PUBLIC SPACE PERMITS & TOPS LOGS: The complete DDOT Transportation Online Permitting System (TOPS) permit application, permit approval file, fee calculation, and approved signage documentation associated with:
   - Reason: "Sewer Emergency Repair"
   - Date Printed: 09/02/2026
   - Contact Agency: DCWATER/ OPS
   - Contact Telephone Number: (202) 612-3400
   - Location: Sixteenth St SE / Square 5815
3. DISPATCH & CONTRACTOR LOGS:  All contractor invoices, subcontractor task orders, equipment mobilization manifests (specifically including Titan vacuum trucks and mechanical bypass pumps), and employee overtime/timesheet records for work performed at this site on October 2, October 3, and October 4, 2026.
4. SIGN MODIFICATION & PERMIT EXTENSION RECORDS:  All communications, emails, work orders, or instructions authorizing or referencing the manual date alteration ("10-9") or extension of the emergency no parking placard printed on 09/02/2026.
5. NATIVE FORMAT & METADATA PRESERVATION DEMAND: Produce all electronic records, including enterprise database logs (Maximo/TOPS) and internal emails, in their native digital formats with all rich metadata intact (including creation dates, modification dates, author IDs, routing data, and system audit trails). Do not "flatten," export, or print digital database records to PDF if such conversion strips, degrades, or destroys the underlying forensic metadata.  
REQUEST FOR EXPEDITED PROCESSING:
Expedited processing is requested pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-532(f) because there is an urgency to inform the public concerning actual government activity involving an active structural landslide and an uncontained public health biohazard adjacent to a designated public school pedestrian route.

REQUEST FOR FEE WAIVER:
Disclosure of the requested records is in the public interest because it will contribute significantly to public understanding of municipal infrastructure management and safety compliance. As a community representative, I do not seek these records for commercial purposes.

Please see attached photographic evidence of the altered public space placard in question, as well as federal correspondence confirming the active infrastructure collapse justifying this expedited request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FRED GAMBLE JR
